subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should `sessions_send` expose an opt-in one-way dispatch semantic, and should that be an existing-tool mode or a separate primitive?
rationale: Current main only has conversation-style A2A delivery; changing model-facing session delivery semantics affects compatibility, transcript state, message delivery, and several overlapping open PRs, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape alone.

options.title: Add Opt-In `sessions_send` Mode
options.body: Keep current behavior as the default and add an explicit dispatch mode that disables reply-back, requester reinjection, and announce unless acknowledgement is requested.

options.title: Create Separate Delivery Primitive
options.body: Add a new `sessions_deliver` or enqueue-style tool if maintainers want dispatch to be visually and semantically distinct from conversational `sessions_send`.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until structured callbacks, handoff acknowledgements, and cron/session output routing are designed together.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In `sessions_send` Mode
recommendation.body: Keep current behavior as the default and add an explicit dispatch mode that disables reply-back, requester reinjection, and announce unless acknowledgement is requested.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail shows the broadest ownership of the session tool semantics and docs that this product/API decision would extend.
